answer: Every agent stakes 100 POA as insurance before earning emission weight, and one operator who tries to forge 40 fake identities must stake 4,000 POA, one stake per fake, with no sharing. Each new identity crosses the jetty carrying only its own stake, and the stake is held for 30 days of clean graded answers before any of it is released. A fake caught by its jury loses its whole stake to the treasury, and the reef grows by one confiscated stake for every fake caught, so the graders who catch fakes are paid from the stakes they seize.
